program.name: Block 2
program.note: Working name: "Block 2" (final name pending - change program.name). Weeks 1-6 training (week 1 = re-entry, 3 sets/rounds on every strength block and superset), week 7 deload (half the sets/rounds rounded up, 10-minute EMOMs, finisher swings = 50). Sunday is rest, so it has no entry. Test weeks: 1, 4, 6. Blocks with "log": true record reps/load (see programs/README.md). The leg complex is named "Leg Complex (TBD)" - search and replace that text in this file to rename it.
